about: How Filo decides what to show and in what order. Code applies these rules; the language model never overrides them. Three outputs are calculated separately and never blended into one opaque score: Match, Quality and Evidence Confidence. Changes to this file go through the golden query tests before they ship; usage data creates a research backlog, it never rewrites these rules automatically.

all_required: passes Filo's existing quality rules (minimum score, under 50% synthetic, blocked and department-store retailers)
the shown variant was checked within the freshness window in data_refresh_policy.md
the shown variant is in stock, preorder or made to order
the shown variant has a price captured within the freshness window

hard_filters.about: Applied before any ranking. A product that fails one is removed, never just ranked lower.

absolute.rule: Shown price in the shopper's currency, before shipping and duties, must be at or under a hard_max budget. Never exceeded unless the shopper says over-budget is fine, and then shown in a separate, labelled 'over budget' group.
Must match the requested category concept or its is_a children.
If the shopper gave a size, that size must be available in the shown colour.
Must ship to the shopper's market (CA or US).
Any excluded material (e.g. no wool, no animal materials) present in composition, lining or trims removes the product. Unknown composition also removes it when an exclusion is set.
A stored fact that contradicts a negation (e.g. 'sheer' stored for 'not sheer') removes the product.

When the shopper requires evidence (e.g. traceable leather, verified certification), the claim must exist at the required source type and scope. brand_wide evidence never satisfies a product-level requirement.
Resale listings appear only when the shopper allows second-hand or asks for vintage.

evidence_gated.about: Musts that depend on evidence (opacity, fit claims, durability claims). conflicts always removes. unknown is allowed only in the single trade-off slot, clearly labelled with what is missing.

match_score.about: How well this product satisfies this brief. 0 to 100. Independent of quality.

components.rule: Share of must requirements with status confirmed (1.0) or from_photo for cut details (0.6). unknown counts 0.
Share of nice requirements met, same scale.
Vibe similarity between the brief or reference brand and the product embedding.
Inside budget = 1.0. Closer to the shopper's stated target range scores higher than far below it.
Shopper's size in stock in the shown colour = 1.0; size not given = share of core sizes in stock.
Only with 'Learn my style' on. Saves, likes and explicit preferences. Never more than this weight.

quality_assessment.about: What the evidence says about how well made it is. Shown as Filo's existing 0 to 100 score plus the rubric profile. Never folded into Match.
rules: Natural fibre, price, origin or a brand statement alone never raise quality.
unknown dimensions are shown as unknown, never as low.

evidence_confidence.about: How complete, direct and current the evidence is behind the claims shown on this card. 0 to 1, shown as High, Medium or Low.
evidence_confidence.freshness_multiplier: 1.0 within the field's freshness window, 0.5 when stale, 0 when source_failed
evidence_confidence.formula: Average over the claims that matter to this brief (its musts plus composition and origin), each weight x scope x freshness.

order: Remove anything failing show_rule or hard_filters.
Within 5 Match points, prefer higher Evidence Confidence, then higher Quality.
Popularity, commission and brand size are never inputs.

diversity.max_per_brand: 2 in a shortlist of up to 5; 3 in up to 15
diversity.price_spread: When Match and Quality are comparable, include at least two price points.
diversity.independent_labels: When an independent or lesser-known label is within 5 Match points of a bigger brand, it gets a slot. Never ranked down for being small.

shortlist_slots.about: Default shortlist is 3 to 5. Each slot is filled only if a product earns it; empty slots are skipped, never padded. Up to 15 when the shopper asks for a number.

slots.label: Best overall
slots.rule: Highest Match among those with High or Medium Evidence Confidence. This is the Stylist's pick.

slots.label: Best value
slots.rule: Cheaper than best_overall with Quality within 10 points and a Good value or Fair price verdict.

slots.label: Best independent label
slots.rule: Highest Match from an independent or lesser-known label not already shown.

slots.label: Best evidence for {requirement}
slots.rule: Use when one requirement matters most to the brief (e.g. opacity). Highest confidence on that claim.

slots.label: Trade-off
slots.rule: At most one. Excellent Match on the cut or aesthetic, but one evidence-gated must is unknown. The note names exactly what is missing. Never used for an absolute hard filter.

shortlist_slots.standard_mode: For basics, use Filo Standards first: best_overall, best_under (budget), best_splurge, as set by Brooklyn, still passing the show rule and hard filters.

no_match.rule: If nothing passes, never relax a hard filter silently. Say which constraints conflict, offer the ones that could flex as choices, and log the gap.
no_match.partial: If fewer than asked pass, show them and say how many.

validation_before_response: Every product ID came from this hunt's search results.
Every claim in a note or card resolves to evidence ledger entries for this product.
No card shows a hard-filter violation.
No em dashes in shopper-facing text.
